_about: A TEST arc for the plug-and-play demo (js/demo/main.js; docs/architecture/building-games.md, the worked example): one chapter, one errand that runs the demo mode's whole plan (Cook's pantry, then the clinic's scrape, both wrapped by adapters), and a Conversation slot. Finishing the chapter opens the demo mode's free play, which shows the whole loop: locked ('locked until the demo story'), played in story mode, open. test: true keeps it off the child's map and bookshelf; lab.html and build/host play it.

chapters.note: Help in the kitchen, then at the clinic.
